name: Moar
locations: Banani 11, Dhanmondi 27, and Gulshan-Tejgaon Link Road.
priceRange: Starter membership BDT 5,000; Infinity all-location membership from BDT 15,000; hour pass BDT 250; day pass BDT 1,000. Meeting rooms start at BDT 250–1,000 depending on capacity.
hours: 8:00–22:00, six days a week; closed Fridays and government holidays.
applicationPath: Hourly and daily Coworking Passes do not require membership or advance booking. Bring a government-issued photo ID and emergency-contact details; enquire separately about offices and memberships.
notes: A three-location coworking network offering hourly and daily access, memberships, meeting rooms, dedicated or private offices and event space. All-location membership suits people who need to move between Banani, Dhanmondi and the Gulshan–Tejgaon Link Road.

name: Impact Hub Dhaka
locations: Mirpur (9th Floor, Grameen Telecom Bhaban, Zoo Road) and Banani (7th Floor, Momen Bari Heights, Plot 157, Road 12).
priceRange: BDT 2,000 per month for 8 hours, BDT 8,000 for 50 hours, BDT 14,000 for 100 hours, or BDT 17,500 for unlimited office hours.
applicationPath: Book a membership, free tour or team call through the co-working page.
notes: A coworking and innovation hub for entrepreneurs, freelancers, professionals and impact-focused teams. Alongside desks and private offices, members can access community events, entrepreneurship programmes, consultancy and connections across the wider Impact Hub network.

name: hubdhaka
priceRange: Premium coworking BDT 9,000 per month; Basic Coworking is currently waitlisted; team rooms are quoted on enquiry.
facilities: Event space for up to 130 people
applicationPath: Submit the membership application for evaluation, then schedule a visit and one-day trial if invited.
notes: A community-oriented Mirpur coworking space for freelancers, entrepreneurs and small teams. Membership includes workspace, backup internet and power, printing, lockers and event facilities without a long-term agreement; admission is application-based.

name: WorkStation 101
locations: Uttara Tower, Level 4, 1 Jashimuddin Avenue, Sector 3, Uttara.
priceRange: Hot desk BDT 100 per hour, BDT 700 per day or BDT 8,000 per month; private offices start from BDT 40,000 per month. Hot-desk prices exclude 15% VAT.
hours: Saturday–Thursday, 9:00 AM–8:00 PM for hot desks and premium desks
applicationPath: Book a desk or room through the co-working page, or contact WorkStation 101 for a private office.
notes: An Uttara coworking space for individual professionals and teams, with hourly, daily and monthly desks, private offices, meeting rooms, event space and virtual-office services.
